name: edgepay-cf
description: EdgePay — self-hosted payment gateway rebuilt on HonoJS + Cloudflare Workers edge runtime

ENABLED_GATEWAYS.description: **140+ gateway plugins** — `stripe`, `paypal`, `bkash`, `razorpay`, `nagad`, `adyen`, `braintree`, `mollie`, `paytm`, `phonepe`, `mtn-momo`, `pix`, `klarna`, `coinbase-commerce`, `apple-pay`, `google-pay`, `2checkout`, `payu`, `worldpay`, `square`… (see [docs/GATEWAYS.md](docs/GATEWAYS.md) for full 172). Comma-separated; aliases like `bkash`→`bkash-api` work. Leave default to enable all 5 implemented now; pending show as 'coming soon' until ported.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API (CORS allowlist), e.g. `https://shop.example.com`. Leave empty to disallow all cross-origin browser calls — server-to-server API calls and hosted checkout keep working either way.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign mobile-companion JWTs. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` (minimum 32 characters) and paste the result.

APP_KEY.description: HMAC key for signing. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32` and paste the result.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: AES-256-GCM key that encrypts gateway credentials and PII at rest. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32` and paste the result. **Store it safely — losing it makes stored credentials unrecoverable.**

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Zero Trust team domain (e.g. `myteam.cloudflareaccess.com`) protecting the admin API. Create one free at <https://one.dash.cloudflare.com>. Leave empty for now — the admin API stays closed (503) until it is set. See [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md).

CF_ACCESS_AUD_TAG.description: The AUD tag of the Cloudflare Access application covering `https://<your-worker>/api/admin/*`. Leave empty for now; configure together with CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.

BREAK_GLASS_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Service-token client id for emergency admin access when Access is unreachable. Only set if you understand the paging implications (docs/SECURITY.md).

BREAK_GLASS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Service-token secret paired with BREAK_GLASS_CLIENT_ID. Every use pages an audit alarm.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. Cloudflare API token for custom-hostname provisioning (Cloudflare for SaaS). Leave empty unless you use per-brand custom domains.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional. Your Cloudflare account id (used with CF_API_TOKEN for custom hostnames).

CF_ZONE_ID.description: Optional. Zone id of the domain custom hostnames live in.

PBKDF2_ITERATIONS.description: Optional. On the **free plan's 10ms CPU budget** the default PBKDF2 600K iterations cannot finish; strictly-free deployments set `100000`. (Stored password hashes embed their own cost, so this only affects NEW hashes.)
